levels.1: Use the expanded handheld release selected for this archive.
levels.2: Play the Nintendo 3DS Redux version rather than the original DS release.
levels.3: Use a physical 3DS copy on hardware or a legally dumped image in a high-accuracy 3DS emulator. Record region, update state, and installed add-ons; Redux contains the added dungeon, route records, demons, missions, and New Cycle options required by this pack.

levels.1: Sweep each floor before leaving its sector.
levels.2: Fill every accessible tile in all sectors, the Womb, and the final added ascent.
levels.3: Walk each floor in all phase states, open one-way and hidden routes, revisit locked doors after every Main App upgrade, and finish the New Cycle-only east side of Grus before judging the map ledger complete.

levels.1: Register every negotiation, fusion, mission, and route unlock as it appears.

levels.3: Register all normally obtainable Redux demons, finish alignment and mission unlocks, clear one original and one Redux route for their fusion permissions, and enter the official password-only records that remain valid in Redux. Debug and removed DS-only forms do not count.
